lines.zh: 骨架相撞，我每走一步都咔咔响。
lines.en: My bones clatter with every step I take.

lines.zh: 长尾拖过地面，划出一道浅沟。
lines.en: My long tail drags, carving a shallow groove.

lines.zh: 我沿着巢穴边缘巡视，数着自己的骨头。
lines.en: I patrol the nest's edge, counting my own bones.

lines.zh: 前肢太短，走路只能靠后腿撑。
lines.en: My forelimbs are short; my hind legs carry me.

lines.zh: 我跨过自己的旧骨，没多看一眼。
lines.en: I step over my own old bones without a glance.

lines.zh: 空腔里灌进风，走起来像在吹哨。
lines.en: Wind fills my hollow ribs and whistles as I walk.

lines.zh: 我绕开松土，那里埋着上一窝蛋。
lines.en: I skirt the loose soil where the last clutch lies buried.

lines.zh: 每块骨头都在原位，这让我安心。
lines.en: Every bone sits in place, and that comforts me.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，骨架经不起摔。
lines.en: I walk slowly; a skeleton does not survive falls.

lines.zh: 巢口的骨堆被风吹散了，我得去理。
lines.en: Wind scattered the bone pile at my nest mouth; I must fix it.

lines.zh: 我趴下时，脊骨一节节落回原位。
lines.en: When I lie down, my spine settles vertebra by vertebra.

lines.zh: 巢里很暖，土还留着上一季的热。
lines.en: The nest is warm; the soil keeps last season's heat.

lines.zh: 没有皮肉，我反倒不怕冷。
lines.en: With no flesh, the cold hardly troubles me.

lines.zh: 我用尾尖在地上画圈，一圈又一圈。
lines.en: I draw circles in the dirt with my tail tip.

lines.zh: 空旷的骨架里，回声比叫声更响。
lines.en: In this hollow frame, echoes are louder than my call.

lines.zh: 我记得自己曾有过一身厚皮。
lines.en: I remember once having a thick hide.

lines.zh: 现在风直接穿过我的肋骨。
lines.en: Now the wind passes straight between my ribs.

lines.zh: 巢底垫着的骨片被我压得很平。
lines.en: The bone plates lining my nest lie flat under me.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看洞顶那一道裂缝。
lines.en: I lift my skull toward the crack in the cavern roof.

lines.zh: 没有人来的时候，我就这样坐着。
lines.en: When nobody comes, I simply sit like this.

lines.zh: 关节处磨得发亮，是走了太多路。
lines.en: My joints are polished bright from too much walking.

lines.zh: 我在等下一枚蛋，或者下一个猎物。
lines.en: I wait for the next egg, or the next prey.

lines.zh: 骨头不会累，可我会烦。
lines.en: Bone does not tire, but I do grow bored.

lines.zh: 我把自己埋进骨堆，只露出头骨。
lines.en: I bury myself in the pile, skull alone showing.

lines.zh: 我把下颌搁在蛋壳上，凉得很。
lines.en: I rest my jaw on the eggshells; they are cold.

lines.zh: 我用爪子把散开的骨片拨回一堆。
lines.en: I nudge the scattered bone shards back into a pile.

lines.zh: 你的体温在这洞里太显眼了。
lines.en: Your body heat stands out in this cave.

lines.zh: 我低下巨大的头骨，正对着你。
lines.en: I lower my huge skull until it faces you.

lines.zh: 你比巢里任何一块骨头都白。
lines.en: You are paler than any bone in my nest.

lines.zh: 你举着火把，我数着它的火星。
lines.en: You raise a torch; I count its sparks.

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩碎了一节脊椎，听见了吗？
lines.en: Your boot crushed a vertebra; did you hear it?

lines.zh: 我眨不了眼，所以你只能被我盯着。
lines.en: I cannot blink, so you will simply be stared at.

lines.zh: 你身上有活物的味道，很淡，很新。
lines.en: You smell of living things: faint and new.

lines.zh: 我把头骨歪了一下，颈骨咔地响。
lines.en: I tilt my skull; a neck bone clicks.

lines.zh: 你在量我的高度，我也在量你的。
lines.en: You measure my height; I measure yours.

lines.zh: 别站在巢的中央，那是留给蛋的。
lines.en: Don't stand at the nest's center; that's for eggs.

lines.zh: 你眼里的光，我很久没见过了。
lines.en: The light in your eyes; I have not seen it in ages.

lines.zh: 我认得这种眼神，来挖骨头的人都有。
lines.en: I know that look; every bone digger wears it.

lines.zh: 一块肋骨被打断，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: A rib snaps loose; I stoop to pick it up.

lines.zh: 你的剑砍在骨头上，只是崩了口。
lines.en: Your sword bites bone and only chips itself.

lines.zh: 我少了半节尾骨，走路会歪。
lines.en: Half a tail bone gone; I will walk crooked.

lines.zh: 这副架子散过一次，我不怕再散。
lines.en: This frame has fallen apart before; I don't fear it.

lines.zh: 疼倒不疼，就是听着心烦。
lines.en: It doesn't hurt; the sound simply annoys me.

lines.zh: 你砍中的是旧伤，那里本来就裂着。
lines.en: You struck an old wound that was already split.

lines.zh: 我退开一步，把散落的骨片护在身下。
lines.en: I step back, shielding the scattered shards beneath me.

lines.zh: 骨头渣落进土里，我记住了位置。
lines.en: Bone dust falls into the soil; I mark the spot.

lines.zh: 你打断了我的步点，这很失礼。
lines.en: You broke my stride; that is rude.

lines.zh: 我的骨架在响，可还没打算散。
lines.en: My frame rattles, but it is not coming apart yet.

lines.zh: 你举着肉，可我没有胃。
lines.en: You hold out meat, but I have no stomach.

lines.zh: 收起来吧，我连舌头都没有。
lines.en: Put it away; I don't even have a tongue.

lines.zh: 想用食物换骨头？我的骨头不卖。
lines.en: Trade food for my bones? They are not for sale.

lines.zh: 你把草料摆在巢口，我踩了过去。
lines.en: You laid greens at my nest mouth; I walked over them.

lines.zh: 我闻得到味道，却尝不出滋味。
lines.en: I can smell it, but I taste nothing.

lines.zh: 别拿胡萝卜逗一头只剩骨架的龙。
lines.en: Don't dangle carrots at a dragon of bare bone.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，喂不饱一副空架子。
lines.en: What you hold cannot fill an empty frame.

lines.zh: 我追的不是食物，是活物的动静。
lines.en: I don't chase food; I chase the stir of the living.

lines.zh: 那串东西晃得我眼窝发亮，仅此而已。
lines.en: That bundle glints in my sockets, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你把诱饵放低点，我就当你投降了。
lines.en: Lower that bait again and I'll call it surrender.

lines.zh: 你的肩撞上我的肋骨，被弹开了。
lines.en: Your shoulder strikes my ribs and bounces off.

lines.zh: 我这一身骨头，比石头还硬。
lines.en: This frame of mine is harder than stone.

lines.zh: 你撞进来，正好卡在两根肋骨中间。
lines.en: You slam in and lodge between two ribs.

lines.zh: 别推我的尾骨，那节快松了。
lines.en: Don't push my tail bones; that joint is loose.

lines.zh: 我侧身让路，骨尾扫过你的腿。
lines.en: I turn aside; my tail sweeps your legs.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的脚骨，我听见了碎裂声。
lines.en: You step on my toe bone; I hear it crack.

lines.zh: 我用肩骨把你顶开半格。
lines.en: I nudge you half a block with my shoulder blade.

lines.zh: 撞我不疼，撞你自己的骨头才疼。
lines.en: Hitting me is painless; hitting your own bones is not.

lines.zh: 你退得太急，后脑撞在我的股骨上。
lines.en: You retreat too fast and crack your head on my femur.

lines.zh: 骨头碰骨头，这声音我很熟。
lines.en: Bone against bone; I know that sound well.

lines.zh: 巢里只剩我，蛋是很多年前的事。
lines.en: I am alone here; the eggs were years ago.

lines.zh: 我守着空巢，等一个不会来的同伴。
lines.en: I guard an empty nest, awaiting a mate who won't come.

lines.zh: 骨架之间没有温度，凑近也没用。
lines.en: Bone holds no warmth; drawing close changes nothing.

lines.zh: 我的同类都成了别人墙上的标本。
lines.en: My kin all ended up mounted on someone's wall.

lines.zh: 求偶的叫声我还会，只是没人应。
lines.en: I still know the courting call; no one answers.

lines.zh: 这副身子生不出后代，我清楚。
lines.en: This body breeds nothing, and I know it.

lines.zh: 巢口那圈骨是我摆给伴侣看的。
lines.en: The bone ring at my nest mouth was arranged for a mate.

lines.zh: 我把最大的那块骨头留在巢中央。
lines.en: I keep the largest bone at the nest's heart.

lines.zh: 孤独比风化更慢地磨掉我。
lines.en: Loneliness wears me down slower than weather.

lines.zh: 若还有一只，我愿让出半个巢。
lines.en: If another remained, I would share half this nest.

lines.zh: 那根骨头掉在地上，我伸爪勾回来。
lines.en: A bone drops; I hook it back with a claw.

lines.zh: 我不捡发亮的东西，只捡骨头。
lines.en: I collect no shiny things, only bone.

lines.zh: 你掉的铁剑，我拨到巢外去了。
lines.en: Your dropped iron sword? I flicked it out of the nest.

lines.zh: 我用嘴叼起骨片，放回该在的位置。
lines.en: I take the shard in my jaws and set it back in place.

lines.zh: 地上每一块骨，我都认得属于谁。
lines.en: Every bone on this floor, I know whose it was.

lines.zh: 那枚头颅滚远了，我去把它衔回来。
lines.en: That skull rolled away; I go retrieve it.

lines.zh: 我不需要战利品，巢里已经够满。
lines.en: I need no trophies; the nest is full enough.

lines.zh: 掉下来的东西，最后都会被踩进土里。
lines.en: Whatever falls here ends up trampled into soil.

lines.zh: 我把新骨排在旧骨旁边，对齐了。
lines.en: I lay the new bone beside the old, lined up.

lines.zh: 你丢下的盾，挡不住巢里的风。
lines.en: The shield you dropped won't stop the wind in here.

lines.zh: 你踏进巢的边界，骨头就开始响了。
lines.en: You crossed the nest line, and my bones began to rattle.

lines.zh: 我抬起头骨，锁定活物的热气。
lines.en: I raise my skull and lock onto living heat.

lines.zh: 洞里只有你一个会喘气的。
lines.en: You are the only breathing thing in this cave.

lines.zh: 你踩到了蛋壳，那就别走了。
lines.en: You stepped on eggshell; now you stay.

lines.zh: 这副骨架终于又有事可做。
lines.en: At last this skeleton has something to do.

lines.zh: 我不追快的，我追慌的。
lines.en: I don't chase the swift; I chase the panicked.

lines.zh: 你的火把把我的影子拉得很长。
lines.en: Your torch stretches my shadow across the wall.

lines.zh: 巢里的骨堆动了一下，那是我起身。
lines.en: The bone pile shifts; that is me rising.

lines.zh: 你在我眼里只是一具还没剥皮的骨架。
lines.en: To me you are a skeleton still wearing its skin.

lines.zh: 这次我不等猎物自己倒下。
lines.en: This time I won't wait for the prey to drop.

lines.zh: 你身后的路我熟，比你熟得多。
lines.en: I know the path behind you better than you do.

lines.zh: 我把重心压到后腿，这是起跑前的动作。
lines.en: I shift weight to my hind legs, the stance before a charge.

lines.zh: 你选了最坏的地方躲，那是我的巢。
lines.en: You picked the worst hiding place: my nest.

lines.zh: 骨头开始发热，我很久没这么兴奋。
lines.en: My bones run hot; it has been long since I was this eager.

lines.zh: 洞口的空气动了一下，我睁开眼窝。
lines.en: The air at the cave mouth shifts; I open my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 你踩碎的那块骨，是我留的记号。
lines.en: That bone you crushed was a marker I left.

lines.zh: 我站起来，骨头一节节扣紧。
lines.en: I rise, and my bones lock into place one by one.

lines.zh: 这副空架子总算等到了活物。
lines.en: This empty frame has finally met something alive.

lines.zh: 我一步一顿地逼近，让你听清每根骨。
lines.en: I close in step by step so you hear each bone.

lines.zh: 你跑到柱子后面，尾巴还是露着。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar, but your tail shows.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，头骨几乎贴地。
lines.en: I lower myself until my skull nearly scrapes the floor.

lines.zh: 你在数我的步子，我一步也没乱。
lines.en: You count my steps; not one has faltered.

lines.zh: 洞口在你背后，我挡在中间。
lines.en: The exit is behind you; I stand between.

lines.zh: 我甩尾，把地上的碎石扫向你。
lines.en: I sweep my tail, flinging gravel your way.

lines.zh: 你换方向了，可我的头骨跟着转。
lines.en: You change direction; my skull turns with you.

lines.zh: 我在等你踩进那片松土。
lines.en: I wait for you to step into that loose soil.

lines.zh: 你的盾举得太高，脚下全空着。
lines.en: Your shield is too high; your feet are wide open.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，下颌骨发出干裂的响。
lines.en: I open my jaws; the hinge grinds dryly.

lines.zh: 这片巢穴的每一寸我都踩过。
lines.en: I have walked every inch of this nesting ground.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越重，我越来越近。
lines.en: Your breath grows heavier; I grow nearer.

lines.zh: 我不需要跑，你跑不出这个洞。
lines.en: I need not run; you cannot leave this cave.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里最容易断。
lines.en: I watch your knees; they break the easiest.

lines.zh: 我把尾巴横过来，封住那道窄口。
lines.en: I swing my tail across and seal the narrow gap.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我骨头就响一声。
lines.en: Each step you back away, one of my bones clicks.

lines.zh: 我压低颈骨，等你先松手。
lines.en: I lower my neck and wait for you to let go first.

lines.zh: 你举盾的姿势在抖，我看见了。
lines.en: Your shield arm is shaking; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我绕着巢壁慢慢转，不着急。
lines.en: I circle the nest wall slowly, in no hurry.

lines.zh: 你背后那块石头，我踩过一千次。
lines.en: I have stepped on that rock behind you a thousand times.

lines.zh: 我把头骨砸下去，土都震了一下。
lines.en: I drive my skull down; the ground jumps.

lines.zh: 尾骨横扫，把你扫到墙边。
lines.en: My tail sweeps you into the wall.

lines.zh: 牙床咬合，只咬到你的护甲边。
lines.en: My jaw clamps down on the edge of your armor.

lines.zh: 前爪按在你胸口，骨头硌得生疼。
lines.en: My foreclaw pins your chest; the bone digs in.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，骨架整副压在你身上。
lines.en: I charge, and the whole frame bears down on you.

lines.zh: 这一口带着土腥味，是巢底的泥。
lines.en: This bite tastes of soil from the nest floor.

lines.zh: 你被顶飞，落进那堆碎骨里。
lines.en: You are flung into the pile of shattered bone.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的披风，把你往回拖。
lines.en: I catch your cloak in my teeth and drag you back.

lines.zh: 骨爪落下，你的盾凹了一块。
lines.en: My claw falls; your shield dents.

lines.zh: 我不用武器，这副骨架就是武器。
lines.en: I carry no weapon; this skeleton is the weapon.

lines.zh: 你挡下第一击，第二击从侧面来。
lines.en: You block the first; the second comes from the side.

lines.zh: 我踩住你的脚，再慢慢咬。
lines.en: I pin your foot, then bite at leisure.

lines.zh: 骨节摩擦出火星，落进你的领口。
lines.en: My joints strike sparks that fall down your collar.

lines.zh: 你退到巢中央，那里没有退路了。
lines.en: You back to the nest's center; there is no further.

lines.zh: 巢底的骨堆慢慢拼成了一具身躯。
lines.en: The bone pile at the nest's floor knits into a body.

lines.zh: 我把自己从土里撑起来，骨上还挂着根须。
lines.en: I push up from the soil, roots still clinging to bone.

lines.zh: 这处巢穴终于又有主人了。
lines.en: This nest has a master once more.

lines.zh: 头骨先立起来，其余骨头跟着归位。
lines.en: The skull rises first; the rest fall into place.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖脊背，抖下一层陈年灰。
lines.en: I shake my spine free of ages of dust.

lines.zh: 上一窝蛋的壳还在，我认得每一片。
lines.en: The last clutch's shells remain; I know each piece.

lines.zh: 洞顶滴水落在我眼眶里，凉得很。
lines.en: Cave water drips into my socket, cold and sharp.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅空气，这里来过活物。
lines.en: I sniff the air; the living have been here.

lines.zh: 骨头拼合时发出很长的咔啦声。
lines.en: A long clatter runs through me as the bones join.

lines.zh: 我不需要血肉，只要一副好骨架。
lines.en: I need no flesh, only a sound frame.

lines.zh: 这座巢我守了很多年，如今又醒了。
lines.en: I have kept this nest for years, and wake again.

lines.zh: 你先听见声音，再看见我，顺序别弄错。
lines.en: You hear me first, then see me; keep that order.

lines.zh: 尾骨最后接上，我甩了一下试试。
lines.en: The tail joins last; I flick it to test.

lines.zh: 我把巢口守住了，谁也别想进来。
lines.en: I hold the nest mouth; no one enters.

lines.zh: 土里先伸出爪骨，然后才是头。
lines.en: Claw bones push out of the soil first, then my head.

lines.zh: 我把脊骨一节节接上，慢得很。
lines.en: I fit my spine together link by link, very slowly.

lines.zh: 巢壁上的骨粉落下来，盖住我。
lines.en: Bone dust falls from the nest wall and covers me.

lines.zh: 这窝骨堆又凑齐了一副身子。
lines.en: This bone heap has gathered itself into a body again.

lines.zh: 我先动了动趾骨，试试能不能站。
lines.en: I flex a toe bone first, testing whether I can stand.

lines.zh: 洞底那口气，把我从土里吹醒。
lines.en: A breath from the cave floor wakes me out of the dirt.

lines.zh: 火苗顺着肋骨爬，骨头炸得噼啪。
lines.en: Flame climbs my ribs, popping and cracking.

lines.zh: 落地时脊骨错开一节，我歪着头。
lines.en: On landing, one vertebra slips; my head tilts.

lines.zh: 水漫过肋骨，我连挣扎都费劲。
lines.en: Water floods my ribs; even struggling is hard.

lines.zh: 冲击震散了三根肋骨，我一根根捡回。
lines.en: The blast shakes three ribs loose; I gather them.

lines.zh: 箭从肋缝穿过去，没伤着什么。
lines.en: The arrow slips between my ribs and harms nothing.

lines.zh: 药水味钻进空腔，我的骨头在发麻。
lines.en: Potion fumes fill my hollow, and my bones go numb.

lines.zh: 我本就吃不下东西，饿只是习惯。
lines.en: I cannot eat anyway; hunger is just a habit.

lines.zh: 雷顺着骨架走了一圈，我站得更直。
lines.en: Lightning runs my frame; I stand straighter.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有土，我的骨头散得很慢。
lines.en: The void has no ground; my bones scatter slowly.
